Idempotency-Replayed.description: Present, with the value `true`, only when this answer is a replay of the stored response of an earlier request with the same `Idempotency-Key`.

201.description: The computed plan (or replayed for a known Idempotency-Key).

windowDays.description: The observation window the demand figures cover.

basis.description: The formula version the plan was computed under.

400.description: The `Idempotency-Key` header is missing (`idempotency-key-required`) or is not 1 to 128 printable ASCII characters (`idempotency-key-invalid`).
